mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.index_id, t1.bookmark_name, t1.position, t1.create_time, t2.index_name from user_bookmark t1 inner join book_index t2 on t1.index_id = t2.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.book_id = #{bookId} order by t1.create_time desc

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.index_id, t1.bookmark_name, t1.position, t1.create_time, t2.index_name, t3.book_name, t3.pic_url, t3.author_name from user_bookmark t1 inner join book_index t2 on t1.index_id = t2.id inner join book t3 on t1.book_id = t3.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} order by t1.create_time desc
